generation.order: The map is a 6×4 grid and each cell has an **80% chance** of holding a beacon, so a sector has at most **{grid}** of them. The lines above are then filled in that order, each rolling its own count, until the beacons run out — so a line near the bottom can get nothing. Whatever is still empty at the end is filled from the shared `{list}` list.
generation.clouds: Clouds are drawn before any of it. A beacon under one is converted and draws from `NEBULA` instead.
generation.clouds_storms: Clouds are drawn before any of it. A beacon under one is converted and draws from `NEBULA` instead — and {storms} of that list's {events} events are plasma storms, which halve your reactor on arrival. Which of them you land on is a draw from the list like any other, not a fixed slot.
generation.cannot_meet_minimum: This table asks for **{min}** beacons against the **{grid}** a map can hold, so the bottom of it is cut every time.
generation.fallback_also_allocated: `{list}` is a numbered line here as well as the fill-in row — one pool, reached two ways, not a doubled row.

legend.must: **Must be placed** — every solid block is filled, as long as the map still has a free beacon when the line comes up.
legend.may: **May be placed** — the line rolls one count between its minimum and its maximum and every outcome is equally likely. {name} rolls {low}–{high}, so each of those {counts} counts is {each}%. A faded block is the chance of **at least** that many: {first}% for one, {last}% for all {high}. Hover any block for its own figure.
legend.may_offset: **May be placed** — the line rolls one count between its minimum and its maximum and every outcome is equally likely. {name} rolls {low}–{high}, so each of those {counts} counts is {each}%. A faded block is the chance of **at least** that many: {first}% for the first faded one, {last}% for all {high}. Hover any block for its own figure.
legend.may_plain: **May be placed** — the line rolls one count between its minimum and its maximum and every outcome is equally likely. A faded block is the chance of **at least** that many. Hover any block for its own figure.
legend.fight: Beacons that always put you in a fight.

markers.distress_note: Note: not every beacon from the `DISTRESS` pool broadcasts a distress signal, and some of these show up in the neutral pools too.
